## Change and validation

Describe the user-visible outcome, regression evidence and any remaining limits.

- [ ] Existing installations, settings, attachments and stable IDs remain compatible.
- [ ] Shipped migrations are unchanged; new migrations have supported-schema upgrade tests.
- [ ] Backup/restore and rollback instructions match any schema/configuration changes.
- [ ] Existing offline queues and API clients remain compatible; no duplicate financial entries.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass, including production-container durability when affected.
- [ ] English/Russian user guides and roadmap statuses are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, real user files or misleading placeholder functionality are published.
